Oracle Fusion Supply Chain & Manufacturing 26D: what's new

26D is the next Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update. Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area list 299 features: 60 on by default, 43 on by default with potential setup, 120 setup required, 64 opt-in, 12 needing another action, per Oracle's "Action to Enable" column. See all 299 →

Get the 26D checklist now: what switches on by itself, which former opt-ins are now standard, what to test

Inside the free 26D checklist (PDF):

  • The 23 opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D: 9 switch on for everyone, 14 need setup
  • 9 HCM Redwood default switches and other HCM notices for 26D
  • 9 baseline regression checks, plus typical 26D test and production dates by cohort

Then one plain-English email per Oracle quarterly update, linked to Oracle's docs. Free. 4 emails a year plus short opt-in alerts. Unsubscribe anytime. Read issue #1 (26C) → · Privacy

We track 25 Supply Chain & Manufacturing changes in 26D, out of 299 features (our count) in Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area. 25 of them are delivered switched on; 0 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Demand Management 26D What's New · Inventory Management 26D What's New · Maintenance 26D What's New · Manufacturing 26D What's New · Order Management 26D What's New · Product Lifecycle Management 26D What's New · Supply Chain Collaboration 26D What's New · Supply Planning 26D What's New · Sales and Operations Planning 26D What's New

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Delivered switched on (25)

Analyze planning results using a Supply Chain Network visualization

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment PlanningRedwood Platform
You can now use the Supply Chain Network visualization in supply plans and replenishment plans to explore upstream and downstream supply networks, from finished goods organizations through intermediate stocking points to supplier sites.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Collect demand history in the targeted mode by organization groups from the Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Suite

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
Collect demand history from the Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Suite by organization groups to improve synchronization and scalability. This collection supports only organizations that are included in both the specified organization groups and organization filters and respects defined collection time ranges.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Configure default filters for page search

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can use the Dimension Catalog's Page Search tab to configure which hierarchy member levels appear as default page-level search facets per plan type. When you edit a plan type, a drawer displays a hierarchical tree of dimensions, hierarchies, and member levels from the Hierarchies tab, with the defaults preselected.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Create a full copy of a demand plan

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now make a full copy of a demand plan. The full plan copy preserves the complete planning history, including archived versions, the audit trail, and planner notes, enabling traceability, faster scenario creation, better governance, and continuity across planning cycles.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Enable parallel runs for load data process during targeted refresh collections

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now Collect Planning Data and Load Planning Data from flat file processes in parallel by organization group. When you select an organization group with targeted or net change refresh, supported collection processes can run in parallel from the user interface, Scheduled Processes, REST service, or job sets.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Enable toolbar in pivot tables in compare mode

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now use a centralized toolbar in the Compare Plans view for quick access to data filters. Apply real-time filters and reusable filter sets while comparing plans, using a consistent toolbar-driven interaction model that streamlines plan comparison and reduces the need to switch context.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Export a list of measures

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can use the Export icon on the Measures page to export the displayed measures to a Microsoft Excel-compatible file. The export includes the same columns shown on the page and preserves their order.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Export details of the plan status

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now use the enhanced Plan Status Details drawer to export the plan-status information. This capability helps you identify failed or delayed steps, retain execution history, and collaborate more easily with other teams.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Filter by a relative date range before or after the plan start date in visualizations

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now configure Redwood visualizations with relative date ranges that start and end before or after the plan start date. On the Time Members subtab on the Data tab in the properties drawer for a visualization, when you set the criteria to Relative to plan start date, the drawer includes Before and After options for both the start and end dates.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Filter by multiple product catalogs

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Replenishment PlanningRedwood Platform
Use category filters in planning visualizations to select categories from the product hierarchies listed in a plan's Dimension Catalog. The Category list of values displays both the category name and the associated product hierarchy, helping you choose the right category when similar category names exist across product hierarchies.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Filter exception results by column values and show exception types based on context

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now apply column filters to narrow order-based and measure-based exception results, including when viewing by exception group. Filters carry over when you drill into Exceptions from pages such as Supplies and Demands, Demand Fulfillment, Resource Requirements, or a pivot table or graph, with filter conditions matched to each column's data type.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Group visualizations and drill-to-action logically

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingDemand Management · Demand ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now add a visualization group to the drill-to-link menu. You can easily access these visualizations through the drill-to action.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Quality Assurance Workspace

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingManufacturing · Quality Inspection ManagementAgentic app
